task: Write process_upload(tmp_path, db_path) that parses the uploaded CSV at tmp_path, inserts each row into the events table of the sqlite database at db_path, and cleans up the temp file when processing is done.

constraints.text: the temp file is removed in a finally block, so it disappears on success and on failure alike
constraints.why: the 2025-11 disk-full page traced to 300 GB of orphaned upload temp files left behind by crashed imports

constraints.text: a failed batch issues an explicit rollback before cleanup runs
constraints.why: half-imported event batches from the 2026-02 crash double-counted revenue in the weekly dashboard for two cycles

constraints.text: after cleanup the original exception continues up to the caller; nothing gets swallowed
constraints.why: a pass-swallowed parse error in 2025-09 marked bad uploads as processed; customers lost data behind a 200 OK

checks.description: exception swallowed with an immediate return
